Test the PR's mergeCommit.oid, which is rc=0 for all seven. A closer keyed on branch names also misses #11320 (head is …-3-r, not …-3) and dr-w30-s3 (whose branch is ABSENT from origin; its work reached main via #11209).

C. DISCARD, NOT CLOSE (3, per charter D491). drafts.task-93206ca8fd299ae7 / drafts.task-c075a65ad4a4e98d / drafts.task-baa72f67d96766ce (issues 11211/11212/11214) — three byte-identical DRAFTS with criteria:null. BOTH their defects are fixed on main (GITHUB_TOKEN is set on the scream step with a comment naming run 31311406793; --now now exits 3 on a non-ISO instant at crown-reconcile.sh:277). Closing them stamps a completion on a row nobody authored.

D. DEDUPLICATE THE CROWN 401 (4 -> 1). task-3e0e34153a7ba0a4 (#11201), task-e2acb66e9ed0da09 (#11218, criteria NULL — unfileable as-is), dr-w29-bl-crown-http-read-path-unreachable-to-the-worker-principal (#11234), dr-w28-rv-crown-reconcile-ci-read-path-has-never-executed (#11204, whose title is now FALSE — the read path HAS executed; run 31311887504 logged the 401 22x). Keep #11234 (best-evidenced, independently reproduced locally); close the other three as duplicates. dr-w30-bl-deliveries-route-widening-is-inside-cch-fence already fences the FIX out of this epic.

E. ANSWERED BY CHARTER D530, closes on it. dr-w30-bl-box-busy-deferred-is-a-dead-arm: already_running (698 rows, last 2026-08-07 08:16:29) was SUPERSEDED by box_at_capacity (2,571 rows, last 2026-08-09 16:09:42, one second before the query). Same writer, same PLAN stage, same 409 seam. The producer is healthy; the arm is still REACHABLE in code (deploy_runner.ex:533 checks running_slug? BEFORE :547 box_at_capacity?), so NO unreachability guard may be proposed.

F. RETITLE, DO NOT CLOSE (1). dr-bl-w7-capacity-is-noise-next-to-two-unset-flags (priority 0) still asserts in the present tense '330 site deploys failed in 12h on an UNSET FLAG' — disproven by D196 and D527.
